__meta: Grafana dashboard model for the E2E contact-center single pane. Import into Azure Managed Grafana; set the 'Azure Monitor' data source and the 'law' (Log Analytics workspace) + 'e2e' variables. Panels query the KQL assets under Agents.AI.Monitoring/Azure/Queries and Dynamics/Queries.
title: Contact Center — E2E Call Observability

panels.title: Live Ops — IVR RED (rate / errors / latency)

azureLogAnalytics.query: AppRequests | where TimeGenerated > ago(1h) | summarize Requests=count(), Failures=countif(Success==false), P95Ms=percentile(DurationMs,95) by bin(TimeGenerated,1m) | order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Transfer Success — ACS accepted vs D365 conversations

azureLogAnalytics.query: AppTraces | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | extend cd=parse_json(Properties) | extend Subscenario=tostring(cd['powerplatform.analytics.subscenario']) | where isnotempty(Subscenario) | summarize Events=count() by Subscenario, bin(TimeGenerated,15m) | order by TimeGenerated asc
